_README: Per-target spec for obol.sh (Daemon) — Robinhood Chain 4663. Every claim carries an evidence string. Sections without evidence are OPEN.

target.name: Daemon (obol.sh)
target.opened: 2026-10-10T18:00:00Z (sale opens; opensAt=1791655200) — audited while LIVE, sold=329 at block 85218989

source.route: Sourcify v2 ?fields=all chain 4663 (Blockscout for this chain is Cloudflare-walled: 403 on /api and /api/v2)
source.note: All three project contracts are exact_match and NOT proxies. Checksums re-derived from the runtime bytecode immutables, not read from the website.

contracts.role: sale (banded, one daemon per tx, 90/10 split)
collection (ERC721Consecutive, all 10048 pre-minted to the sale)
DaemonAccount — ERC-6551 implementation for every daemon wallet (holds 90% of each sale)
USDG traded/charged inside the account (Paxos USDG), proxy -> 0x68184c449e1a8f34fa18d289737129fd27b66f8f

target.coverage_gap: none known. $DAEMON (0x242edd4e...) is a separate Pons/Uniswap-v4 token explicitly excluded from the sale by the docs — out of scope, not mapped.

integrations.name: ERC-6551 registry singleton
integrations.notes: canonical 0x0000...5758; sale calls createAccount (idempotent) — an existing account is reused, and the address is impl-bound so a third party cannot substitute code

integrations.name: USDG (Paxos)
integrations.notes: EIP-3009 confirmed live (authorizationState(address,bytes32) responds, DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() responds, name='Global Dollar'). Account hardcodes the canonical TransferWithAuthorization typehash (keccak verified with cast).

integrations.name: obol.sh web/agent runtime
integrations.notes: serves tokenURI art (https://obol.sh/d/<n>/os), the agentfile execution, and the trait/seed reveal. NOT anchored on-chain — see F3.

integrations.name: treasury Safe
integrations.notes: receives the 10%; the Safe address is also DaemonNFT.owner (marketplace metadata only — verified no powers in DaemonNFT: no setter, no mint, no pause)

actors.name: buyer
can: buy any unsold daemon by paying exactly the current band price
withdraw everything from the daemon wallet it then holds
cannot: pay less than the current band price
obtain a daemon without incrementing sold

actors.name: deployer
can: setNft(address) ONCE, before it is set
actors.verified_how: nft already set (0x47ccca02 -> 0x1BD7...) so setNft is permanently dead; all other params immutable (immutableReferences decoded from runtime bytecode)

actors.name: daemon holder
can: execute() anything from that daemon's wallet
actors.verified_how: DaemonAccount.owner() reads IERC721(tokenContract).ownerOf(tokenId) live; live check token0/token1 account.owner() == nft.ownerOf()

actors.name: daemon agent
can: call allowlisted targets inside per-call caps
send tokens back to the holder
pre-approve one EIP-3009 payment to an allowlisted payee
cannot: act after the NFT changes hands (InertAfterTransfer)

actors.name: treasury (SHYGUY LLC)
actors.verified_how: no code path to treasury except the 10% call in buy()

assumptions.statement: The publisher pre-commits the trait table and the seed before the sale so no one can pick rare daemons.
assumptions.breaks_if: the seed is ground off-chain before its hash is published, or the hashes are not anchored anywhere immutable (F3)

assumptions.statement: accountImpl will always resolve owner() from the NFT, so a daemon wallet always follows the token.
assumptions.breaks_if: accountImpl is a different implementation; verified NOT to be the case here — owner() reads ownerOf() live (account line 89-93)

assumptions.statement: A daemon's agent is untrusted and must be unable to exceed the holder's stated limits.
assumptions.breaks_if: the per-day accounting does not cover every outflow path (F1 — ETH has no daily cap)

assumptions.statement: USDG honours ERC-1271 so an account's pre-approved EIP-3009 digest can be executed by a relayer.
assumptions.breaks_if: USDG validates 3009 signatures by ecrecover only — then approvePayment marks digests nobody can use. OPEN (needs testnet PoC).

invariants.statement: nft.balanceOf(sale) == supply - sold (every increment of sold corresponds to exactly one daemon leaving)
toWallet + toTreasury == price exactly, with toWallet == 90%
invariants.result: PASS on 92/92 events in a 20k-block window

invariants.statement: bandPrice[i] == floor(0.01e18 * 1.3^i) and bandPrice[9] == 0.10604499373 ETH as advertised
invariants.result: PASS — all ten exact, no rounding drift

invariants.statement: The sale holds no ETH between transactions
treasury balance == sold * (price - 90%) for a single-band run
A daemon wallet answers to the NFT holder and nobody else
currentBand() is always a valid index into bandPrice[0..9]
invariants.result: FAIL at sold == supply (returns 10) -> index OOB -> panic

never_should_happen.statement: A buyer pays less than the current band price, or gets a daemon without paying
never_should_happen.attempt: static: msg.value != p reverts; ownerOf != address(this) reverts; ++sold after both checks

never_should_happen.statement: An outsider extracts ETH from the sale contract
never_should_happen.attempt: static: no receive/fallback, no withdraw, both value calls are forwards in the same tx and the sale ends at 0; fork: buy() with wrong value / an already-sold token / before opensAt all revert
never_should_happen.evidence: INV-4; buy() carries every gate before value moves; fork pass D

never_should_happen.statement: A third party substitutes the daemon wallet implementation or hijacks an existing account
never_should_happen.attempt: static: address is CREATE2-bound to (impl, salt=0, chainId, nft, tokenId); registry returns early when code exists; no attacker can deploy other code there
never_should_happen.evidence: DaemonSale.walletOf / registry createAccount idempotency; 173-byte minimal proxies observed for sold tokens

never_should_happen.statement: The agent exceeds the holder's stated limits
never_should_happen.attempt: FORK, armed agent (maxPerCall=1 USDG, maxPerDay=1 USDG, maxEthPerCall=0.005 ETH): 5 x execute() to an allowlisted target; then 3 x approve(spender, 1 USDG)
never_should_happen.result: SUCCEEDED (the stated ceiling is not enforced) — 0.025 ETH left the wallet while spentToday() stayed 0; approvals also never increment spentToday
never_should_happen.evidence: TARGETS/_obol_fork.py pass B/B2: wallet 1.000 -> 0.975 ETH, payee +0.025, spentToday 0 both times. Cause: Constitution has no maxEthPerDay and _spend is only called on the general path (DaemonAccount.sol:152-157)

never_should_happen.statement: A contract buyer (or the publisher) can make USDG accept a 3009 payment signed by the daemon account without the account's key
never_should_happen.attempt: FORK: approvePayment to mark a digest, then transferWithAuthorization with a zero-filled signature; control with an unapproved nonce
never_should_happen.result: blocked for outsiders, and the intended mechanism works — approved digest -> InsufficientFunds (signature accepted); unapproved -> InvalidSignature
never_should_happen.evidence: TARGETS/_obol_fork.py pass E: 0x356680b7 vs 0x8baa579f. Only the account's owner/agent can approve a digest (constitute/approvePayment are owner/agent-gated)

never_should_happen.statement: A buyer over-pays because the band moved
never_should_happen.attempt: static: exact-value match means a moved band reverts the tx instead of overcharging

passes.scope: anvil --fork-url rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com --chain-id 4663 --auto-impersonate; sellout index, agent ETH drain, approve accounting, wallet takeover, buy() gates, USDG ERC-1271
hypotheses: an armed agent can exceed maxPerDay via ETH
an outsider can take over an unsold daemon wallet
USDG accepts an ERC-1271 approval for a 3009 payment
passes.result: A: F2 REPRODUCED (panic 0x32 at currentBand=10; band 9 prices fine at 0.10604499373). B: F1 REPRODUCED — wallet 1.000 -> 0.975 ETH in 5 agent execute() calls while spentToday() stayed 0. B2: approve() never touches spentToday (1.000 -> 1.000, spentToday 0). C: takeover BLOCKED (account owner stayed the sale; attacker execute reverted). D: WrongPrice / NotForSale / NotOpen all blocked. E: USDG DOES consult ERC-1271 — zero-filled signature with a pre-approved digest reverted InsufficientFunds(0x356680b7), the same call with an unapproved nonce reverted InvalidSignature(0x8baa579f).

open_questions: RESOLVED — USDG honours ERC-1271 for EIP-3009: proven on the fork (approved digest passes the signature gate with a zero-filled signature; an unapproved nonce returns InvalidSignature). x402 is functional.

The agent path is not yet live: every sampled sold wallet has an empty constitution and state=1, so F1 was proven on a fork with the holder arming the agent exactly as the UI would. Activation is Sun 11 Oct 18:00 UTC — re-check a live constitution after that.

Reentrancy through buy() reasoned but not run (no callback exists: no ERC721 hook, empty receive(), Safe treasury). Low value — sold increments before any external call and every buy() demands its own payment.
